environment.execution: isolated development environment, not user Windows repository

notes: Decision replay reconstructs only truth known at decision time and rejects future-knowledge contamination.
A loss is not automatically classified as bad analysis; clean losses become signal-error candidates pending independent review.
A win is not automatic proof of analysis quality; PUSH/VOID produce no performance judgment.
Data-quality, coverage, timing, provider-correction, execution and settlement issues are separated from model/signal attribution.
The isolated suite count must not be represented as the user repository count until consolidated integration is verified on the user machine.
scope: Decision Replay, Error Attribution & Learning Integrity Governance
